# Frida GUI Helper v1.0.8

> Starting with this release, Frida GUI Helper is distributed as a Windows installer instead of a standalone executable.<br>
> 从本版本开始，Frida GUI Helper 改为使用 Windows 安装包发布，不再提供单独的便携版可执行文件。

## Features / 新功能

- Added a Windows installer with a user-selectable installation directory.<br>
  新增 Windows 安装程序，用户可以自行选择软件安装目录。

- Bundled a self-contained Frida 17.16.4 environment, including portable Python, Frida CLI, and Android frida-server binaries.<br>
  安装包内置独立的 Frida 17.16.4 环境，包含便携版 Python、Frida CLI 和 Android frida-server。

- Added automatic Android ABI detection and matching bundled frida-server deployment for `arm64`, `arm`, `x86_64`, and `x86`.<br>
  新增 Android ABI 自动识别，并为 `arm64`、`arm`、`x86_64` 和 `x86` 推送对应的内置 frida-server。

- Added a Settings page for application and Frida update checks, Frida automatic updates, and update notifications.<br>
  新增设置页面，支持软件与 Frida 更新检查、Frida 自动更新以及更新通知设置。

- Added visible progress for Frida component downloads and preparation.<br>
  新增 Frida 组件下载和准备过程的可视化进度。

## Fixes / 修复

- Fixed frida-server SHA-256 failures caused by mixing compressed asset hashes with extracted binary hashes.<br>
  修复混用压缩包哈希与解压后二进制哈希导致的 frida-server SHA-256 校验失败问题。

- Fixed version ambiguity when the computer already had Frida but the Android device had no frida-server.<br>
  修复电脑已有 Frida、手机端没有 frida-server 时版本选择不明确的问题。

- Removed interference from system-installed Python, Frida, parent directories, working directories, and PATH entries.<br>
  排除系统 Python、Frida、父目录、工作目录和 PATH 环境对软件内置运行环境的干扰。

- Ensured the bundled Frida CLI and the frida-server running on the device use the same version.<br>
  确保内置 Frida CLI 与设备端实际运行的 frida-server 版本一致。

## Security & Reliability / 安全与可靠性

- Android server assets are downloaded from the official `frida/frida` GitHub Releases and fail closed when an official SHA-256 digest is missing or invalid.<br>
  Android server 资源来自 `frida/frida` 官方 GitHub Releases；官方 SHA-256 缺失或无效时会拒绝继续安装。

- Downloaded compressed assets and extracted frida-server binaries are verified separately.<br>
  分别校验下载的压缩资源与解压后的 frida-server 二进制文件。

- Frida updates are built and validated in a staging directory before an atomic version switch; failures preserve the working runtime.<br>
  Frida 更新会先在暂存目录完成构建与校验，再执行版本切换；失败时保留当前可用环境。

- The installer and uninstaller protect unrelated files in user-selected installation directories.<br>
  安装与卸载程序会保护用户自选安装目录中的无关文件。

- Installer / 安装包：`Frida-GUI-Helper-v1.0.8-windows-amd64-setup.exe`
